providers.name: UniProtKB Subunit & Structural Annotations

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 2 (High-Throughput Batch Streaming via /uniprotkb/stream) & Fallback Invariant 3 (Non-Standard Redirect Protocols on /idmapping)

limitations: Unstructured free-text subunit annotations require regex normalization
Uncharacterized bacterial sequences frequently lack curated subunit records
providers.operational_notes: Primary baseline database for curated experimental stoichiometry annotations and cross-references.

providers.name: RCSB PDB Sequence Search & Core Entry API

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Unsupported Specialized Endpoint - Complex JSON/GraphQL Search Query DSL)

limitations: Asymmetric crystal lattice units often differ from functional biological units
Requires sequence coverage tier gating (D-02) and PISA assembly qualification (D-01)
providers.operational_notes: Subject to target-chain coverage tiers: >=90% High Confidence, 70-89% Qualifying, <70% Provenance-Only.

providers.name: PDBe PISA (Protein Interfaces, Surfaces and Assemblies)

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Unsupported Specialized Endpoint - Direct REST client with requests/httpx)

limitations: Pre-calculated for deposited PDB entries only
User-uploaded unreleased models cannot be calculated via public REST without local PISA binary
providers.operational_notes: Provides biophysical Delta G diss (kcal/mol) interface validation; governs conflict retention (D-03) and multi-assembly ranking (D-04).

providers.name: Complex Portal (EMBL-EBI)

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Unsupported Specialized Endpoint - Direct EBI Complex Portal REST API)

limitations: Coverage concentrated heavily on model organisms; low representation of novel bacterial proteomes
providers.operational_notes: Golden standard for validated, non-redundant macromolecular complexes.

providers.name: IntAct Molecular Interaction Database

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (PSICQUIC REST for advanced PSI-MI XML/JSON records)

limitations: Captures interaction topology and affinity, not atomic 3D quaternary coordinates or symmetry
providers.operational_notes: Supplies candidate partner hypotheses for predictive multimer modeling.

providers.name: BioGRID Interaction Datasets

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Direct REST query with accesskey parameter)

limitations: Requires active API registration key
Must filter out genetic synthetic lethality interactions; keep only physical assays
providers.operational_notes: Provides broad physical interactome data for candidate multimer hypothesis generation.

providers.name: SWISS-MODEL Repository

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Unsupported Specialized Endpoint - SIB SWISS-MODEL Repository REST API)

limitations: Only indexes pre-calculated models for known UniProt entries; no arbitrary novel sequences
providers.operational_notes: Yields Quaternary Structure Model Quality Estimates (QMQE) based on homology templates.

providers.name: SWISS-MODEL Automodel API

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 3 (Ticket-based async polling protocol with Bearer token authentication)

providers.rate_limits: Max 5 concurrent modeling jobs per user account
limitations: Requires active Expasy user API token
Job queue duration depends on server load
providers.operational_notes: Allows comparative modeling of novel sequences with explicit oligomeric templates.

providers.name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database (v4)

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Unsupported Specialized Endpoint - Direct REST Client)

limitations: Single-chain monomeric models only; strictly prohibited from asserting oligomeric state (D-05)
Does not model inter-chain interfaces or quaternary stoichiometry
providers.operational_notes: Provides tertiary structural context only; pLDDT confidence scores preserved separately per D-08.

providers.name: AlphaFold-Multimer & ColabFold Batch

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Unsupported Specialized Execution - Local container / CLI runner)

providers.rate_limits: Bounded by GPU VRAM and compute capacity (typical runtime 3-20 minutes/complex)
limitations: Computationally intensive (requires >= 16GB GPU VRAM)
Strictly caller-opt-in requiring explicit partner or self-association hypothesis per D-06
providers.operational_notes: Deep learning co-folding for complex assemblies; model confidence defined as 0.8*ipTM + 0.2*pTM.

providers.name: GalaxyHeteromer Multimer Modeling Server

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (Web-only server with no programmatic API)

providers.rate_limits: Server web queue (latencies 30 min to several hours)
limitations: Lacks stable public REST API; requires manual HTML scraping / browser queue monitoring
Not suitable for automated headless batch pipelines
providers.operational_notes: Cataloged for interactive web verification and benchmarking reference.

providers.name: ClusPro 2.0 Protein-Protein Docking Server
providers.rate_limits: Max 2 concurrent queued docking jobs per user
limitations: Rigid-body docking assumption; does not simulate induced fit or backbone co-folding
Requires academic registration credentials
providers.operational_notes: Tests binary interface feasibility using AlphaFold DB tertiary monomer models.

providers.name: ESMFold / ESM Metagenomic Atlas

bioservices_integration.fallback_invariant: Fallback Invariant 1 (ESM Metagenomic Atlas REST endpoint)

limitations: Single-chain folding only; does not predict quaternary multimer assemblies
Sequence length constrained on public endpoint (~400 residues)
providers.operational_notes: Ultra-fast monomer fallback for unindexed novel sequences lacking pre-computed AlphaFold DB entries.
